header.running_head: The Enthusiasm of the Sahabah (RA) to Die and Give their Lives in the path of Allaah

blocks.text: to challenge Waleed bin Utba. The two were young and of equal physique. By turning the palm of his hand and placing it on the ground, the narrator indicated that Hadhrat Ali (RA) floored Waleed and killed him. Thereafter, Shayba bin Rabee'ah stood up and Hadhrat Hamza (RA) got up to accept the challenge. These two men were also of equal build. Raising his hands even higher, the narrator indicated in a like manner that Hadhrat Hamza (RA) killed Shayba.

Thereafter, when Utba stood up, Hadhrat Ubaydah bin Haarith (RA) got up to accept his challenge. The narrator pointed to two pillars and added that the two men were like those pillars. When the two men exchanged blows, the blow of Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA) left Utba's left arm dangling. However, Utba got close and struck at Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA)'s leg with his sword, severing his calf. Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Hamza (RA) then returned and settled Utba's affair. They then carried Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA) away to Rasulullaah ﷺ beneath a canopy. When they made him over to Rasulullaah ﷺ, the Nabi of Allaah ﷺ made him lie down. Rasulullaah ﷺ took his head on his lap and started to wipe the dust from his face when Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA) said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Had Abu Taalib seen me now, he would be convinced that his words are more applicable to me than him when he said (with regards to protecting Rasulullaah ﷺ):

blocks.arabic_text:
وَنُسْلِمُهٗ حَتّٰى نُصَرَّعَ حَوْلَهٗ
وَنَذْهَلَ عَنْ اَبْنَائِنَا وَالْحَلَائِلِ
blocks.text:
We shall protect him until we are wounded and fall dead around him
Being totally oblivious of our own children and wives"

Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA) then asked, "Am I not a martyr?" "Certainly," replied Rasulullaah ﷺ, "and I am witness to the fact." He then passed away. Rasulullaah ﷺ buried him in (a valley called) Safraa and himself went into the grave (to lay the body). Rasulullaah ﷺ had never before that entered the grave of any person.[^1]

Hadhrat Zuhri narrates that when Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA) and Utba exchanged blows, the blow of each one incapacitated the other. Returning to the battlefield, Hadhrat Ali (RA) and Hadhrat Hamza (RA) approached Utba and killed him. They then carried their companion away. When they came to Rasulullaah ﷺ, Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA)'s leg was severed and his arteries were bleeding profusely. When the two men brought Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA) to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he asked, "Am I not a martyr, O Rasulullaah ﷺ?" "Certainly," came the reply. Hadhrat Ubaydah (RA) then said, "Had Abu Taalib been alive, he would be convinced that his words are more applicable to me than him when he said:

blocks.arabic_text:
وَنُسْلِمُهٗ حَتّٰى نُصَرَّعَ حَوْلَهٗ
وَنَذْهَلَ عَنْ اَبْنَائِنَا وَالْحَلَائِلِ
blocks.text:
We shall protect him until we are wounded and fall dead around him
Being totally oblivious of our own children and wives"
Ibn Asaakir, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.5 Pg.272).
